in_sanskrit.name: Kosha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sheath, Container
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kosha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hinduism, Kosha refers to the five layers of the human soul - Annamaya Kosha (physical body), Pranamaya Kosha (energy body), Manomaya Kosha (mental body), Vijnanamaya Kosha (intelligent body), and Anandamaya Kosha (blissful body). The name Kosha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kosha' which means 'sheath' or 'container'.
